title: 第12章 燧石村的珍宝烩第13章 慷慨的赠送
content_zh:
车队重整并告别难民后，继续向着目的地前进。
在傍晚时分，燧石村才出现在道路前方。
远远的就能瞧见包裹着村庄的木质城墙和城墙中间的塔楼，城墙上旌旗飞舞，偶尔还能看见来回走动的守卫。
这下众人才慢慢放松下来。
那群野狼再怎么凶恶，也不敢在人类的村庄周围惹事。
“凯斯老兄没事吧？”鲍勃回头看了眼悄悄对柯林说道：“他那表情活像是吃了口热乎屎的。”
柯林耸了耸肩说：“小孩子闹脾气罢了。”
“咱听着呢！”凯斯不满的声音从后面传来，“人类这种族真扯淡！”
鲍勃笑了两声感叹道：“说实话这趟可真够危险的，我上次被上百个哥布林围攻的时候也不过如此啦！”
现在也算安全了，柯林才想了想刚刚的战况。
刚刚的狼群袭击当中。
车队里的几匹马都受了点轻伤，二十五个活人也几乎人人带伤，除了鲍勃之外的几个车夫身上都挂了彩。
七个冒险者付出了生命的代价，其中三人都是死于白狼的吐息。
狼群则留下来了十几匹野狼。
为了答谢那群起到关键作用的难民，野狼的肉都被留下，而剥下来的生皮则被放在了马车上。
这样算下来，每个人都能搞点外快。
柯林看了眼自己的面板。
【委托：护送马车】
【评级：3（凡夫俗子）】
【奖励：熟练度+150】

这么多熟练度都比得上一个多月的训练了。
另外，经过前几天的训练和刚刚那一战，施法能力的熟练度已经达到了497点。
还差最后一点熟练度等级就要升级了。
也不知道升级之后究竟会发生什么，但应该是件好事。不过这一百五十点熟练度也得回到千桅城，彻底将任务完成后才能领取了，毕竟护送马车的委托是一来一回的。
在他思考的时候。
马车缓缓来到村庄门前。
一群卫兵正在检查来往马车顺带收税。
“怎么回事？”一个卫兵过来盘问道。
“我们被狼群袭击了，大人。”
“我们这里没有狼群。”
“可……”
“你知道什么时候会有狼群吗？”卫兵面无表情地说：“村长亲手盖章的悬赏令贴在酒馆公告栏的时候，懂了吗？外地的！”
“懂了，懂了……”鲍勃熟练地往对方手里塞了几枚铜子，车队这才被放进了大门。
content_en:
After regrouping and bidding farewell to the refugees, the convoy continued towards its destination.
In the evening, the village of Flint appeared in front of the road.
From a distance, you can see the wooden city wall surrounding the village and the tower in the middle of the wall. Flags are flying on the wall, and occasionally you can see guards walking back and forth.
Now everyone slowly relaxed.
No matter how ferocious the pack of wild wolves were, they would not dare to cause trouble around the human village.
"Is Brother Keith okay?" Bob looked back and whispered to Colin: "His expression looked like he had taken a mouthful of hot shit."
Colin shrugged and said, "It's just a child having a tantrum."
"Let's listen!" Case's dissatisfied voice came from behind, "The human race is really bullshit!"
Bob laughed twice and sighed: "To be honest, this trip is really dangerous. The last time I was besieged by hundreds of goblins was nothing like this!"
Now that it was considered safe, Colin thought about the battle just now.
During the wolf attack just now.
Several horses in the convoy were slightly injured, and almost all of the twenty-five living people were injured. Except for Bob, several coachmen were injured.
Seven adventurers paid the price with their lives, and three of them died from the white wolf's breath.
The wolf pack left a dozen wild wolves behind.
In order to thank the group of refugees who played a key role, the meat of the wild wolves was left behind, and the skinned hides were placed on the carriage.
After all, everyone can make some extra money.
Colin glanced at his panel.
[Commission: Escort the carriage]
[Rating: 3 (ordinary people)]
[Reward: Proficiency +150]
This amount of proficiency is comparable to more than a month of training.
In addition, after the training of the past few days and the battle just now, the proficiency of spell casting ability has reached 497 points.
There is still one last point left to upgrade the proficiency level.
I don’t know what exactly will happen after the upgrade, but it should be a good thing. However, these 150 points of proficiency can only be collected after returning to Thousand Mast City and completely completing the task. After all, the commission to escort the carriage comes and goes.
while he was thinking.
The carriage slowly arrived in front of the village gate.
A group of guards were checking the carriages and collecting taxes.
"What's going on?" A guard came over and asked.
"We were attacked by wolves, my lord."
"We don't have wolves here."
"But..."
"Do you know when there will be a pack of wolves?" the guard said expressionlessly: "When the reward order stamped by the village chief is posted on the bulletin board of the tavern, do you understand? It's from out of town!"
"Got it, got it..." Bob skillfully stuffed a few coins into the opponent's hand, and then the team was let through the gate.
